# Fabien Chung — solodeveloping.com

> Fabien Chung is a Montréal-based Next-Gen Full-Stack Developer with
> 20+ years of experience. He specializes in Flutter mobile apps,
> React 19 / Node.js web platforms, and advanced AI automation
> ("Maîtrise avancée des IA"). Co-founder of 3 startups. Works solo,
> direct with clients, no agency middlemen.

## Identity

- Name: Fabien Chung
- Alternate names: Fab Chung, KooliFab
- Role: Next-Gen Full-Stack Developer
- Location: Montréal, Quebec, Canada
- Availability: Freelance and contract work, open to full-time roles in Montréal; remote worldwide, also serves UAE
- Website: https://solodeveloping.com
- Languages: English, French

## Expertise

- Mobile: Flutter (since 2018, 15+ shipped apps), native iOS / Swift (since 2012), Android
- Web: React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, tRPC, Vite, Astro, Tailwind CSS
- AI: daily agentic development (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Jules) with specs, contracts, tests and CI as guardrails; LLM integration, multi-LLM content pipelines, n8n automation, MCP servers
- Backend & data: PostgreSQL (RLS, RPC, pgTAP tests), Supabase (Auth, Realtime, Edge Functions), Prisma, Firebase, Cloudflare R2, AWS, GitHub Actions, Docker
- Other: Blockchain, product ownership, 3 startup co-founder experience

## Products

- Applications Ben Cool (https://bencool.ca): Fabien's company, publisher of his apps on the App Store and Google Play
- Artkiddo (2026): children's artwork preservation — Flutter, Supabase PostgreSQL with RLS, ~25 Edge Functions, Cloudflare R2
- Grimora (2026): local-first flashcards (FSRS-6) on 5 platforms — Flutter, SQLite, Supabase
- BarcodeVibe (https://barcodevibe.com): grocery price comparison — Flutter, Supabase, React / TypeScript SEO site
- Hiiba (https://hiiba.ae): donation marketplace in the UAE, co-founder & CTO — Flutter, Supabase Realtime, Next.js admin
- ZeLoop (https://zeloop.net): eco-rewards platform, co-founder & CTO — white label, multi-chain reward API, ZeLoop Exchange (https://exchange.zeloop.net/)
- LOVT (2024–2025, ended): services marketplace for young people, co-founder & CTO — 2,000 sign-ups in 1 month via a PWA strategy
- Cogni's Adventures (https://cognibook.com): interactive children's book companion app, founder — Flutter, Firebase
- pwa_installer (https://pub.dev/packages/pwa_installer): open-source Flutter package
